answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. By the hollow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The comet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the knoll is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
